data.body: OPERATOR RULING (2026-08-21): the ci-gate-compat criterion has been REPEATEDLY rejected and stays rejected. Prior rejection on record: 6f2e-58a5 (closed 2026-08-19, operator decision verbatim: when a new hard-fail gate breaks an in-flight branch the remedy is to rebase on origin/main, correct the actual gate failure, and update the failing change; a grandfathering criterion institutionalises working around gate failures). Consequence for this ticket's P0: the ci-gate-compat half of P0 is resolved as RECORD-THE-DECLINE — it must never be re-proposed as build work. The gap-analysis doc (docs/experiments/escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md:92) still lists it as an open recommendation; a doc fix recording the rejection is being dispatched separately. Ruling on the remaining P0 (import-integrity)/P1/P2/P3 is still pending.
